conclusion.statement: M8 defines and implements similarity-evidence searches, but its pinned runtime is unavailable here and its results are not a biological classifier. M7 is optional recurrence context. M9–M15 provide analyses and review/provenance artifacts, not a frozen final acceptance classifier. End-to-end synthetic candidate specificity is therefore not demonstrated.
